entry.name: Sparsh-X dataset (Allegro part)
entry.title: Tactile Beyond Pixels: Multisensory Touch Representations for Robot Manipulation
entry.summary: Allegro hand on a Franka Panda with four Digit 360 fingertips dipping into trays of LEGO bricks and marbles, released as raw ROS 2 MCAP bags (tactile images, contact audio, IMU, pressure, joint states, RealSense RGB-D); the handheld-picker part of the Sparsh-X set is excluded.
entry.hand: Allegro Hand (16 DoF) on Franka Panda

sensor.note: Per Digit 360 (topics /d360_0 .. /d360_3) in the MCAP: image_raw/compressed and tactile_image, both 1280x720 JPEG at 30 Hz; pressure_topic (pressure ~93,600-93,900, Pa by range, + temperature) at 200 Hz; pressure_ap_topic (2 x 25 uint16 per message) at ~910 msg/s; mic_0 and mic_1 (512 float32 samples per message, 48 kHz); imu_raw_topic (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, linear acceleration, ~390 Hz each) and imu_quat_topic (~100 Hz); ght_topic (gas, humidity, temperature) at ~5 Hz; binary_tactile_array (16 float32, all zero in the checked messages).

scale.text: Paper: 4.5 of the 18.6 h Sparsh-X set come from the Allegro hand (8 sequences of ~8.5 min, four sensors each). Release: one 30.4 GB archive of MCAP bags; its first bag (lego_dip, 13.1 GB) covers 100 s

entry.access: Hugging Face facebook/sparsh-x-dataset, ungated: 5 tar.gz archives (89.5 GB). The Allegro part is d360/20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz (30.4 GB, raw MCAP bags) plus d360/20240601-fre-metahand.tar.gz (2.4 MB, labels only). A tar.gz can only be read from the start.
caveats: The dataset card describes one data.pickle per sequence, but in every archive checked data.pickle is a symlink to an absolute cluster path (/fsx-gum/shared/...). 20240601-fre-metahand.tar.gz (32 sequences: knife cutting, pan stirring, spatula tapping) therefore holds only metadata.yaml/info.yaml files and no sensor data.

20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz holds raw ROS 2 MCAP bags with uncompressed chunks. Its first member, 1-none/lego_dip.mcap, is 13.1 GB for 100 s (bag_start/bag_end in metadata.yaml), ~124 MB/s, mostly raw RealSense images.

The rest of the 30.4 GB archive was not listed: gzip has no index, so a listing needs the whole download. The repository's SSL config names 5 sequences in this set (dip lego x 2, dip marble, pour water bottle x 2); whether all of the paper's 8 Allegro sequences of ~8.5 min are released is not confirmed.
The paper's 18.6 h include 14.1 h from a handheld two-finger picker (d360/2024*-trash_picker archives, 59 GB); this entry covers only the Allegro hand.
The 4.5 h Allegro figure matches sensor-hours (8 sequences x 8.5 min x 4 sensors = 4.5 h), i.e. about 1.1 h of recording time; the paper does not say which it counts.
No episode index file: labels (object, action, surface, bag start/end) are in metadata.yaml next to each dangling data.pickle.
tf_static lists ReSkin links on the Allegro phalanges and palm, but no ReSkin topic appears in the first 2.4 s of lego_dip.mcap. The compressed depth topics carry empty images (88-byte messages).

tracking.system: Allegro 16 joint positions, velocities and efforts (/allegroHand/joint_states, ~336 Hz) + /allegroHand/joint_cmd (~34 Hz)

tracking.note: /joint_states merges arm and hand (23 joints, ~71 Hz)
with /teleop_tool_desired_joint_pose (14 values) these suggest teleoperation; the paper only says the hand 'performs random motions'

other: Digit 360 contact microphones, 2 per sensor, 48 kHz
RealSense infrared stereo pair and camera_info/extrinsics

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/sparsh-x-dataset d360/20240601-fre-metahand.tar.gz and d360/20241009-fre-trash_picker.tar.gz (downloaded whole, 2.4 MB and 0.6 MB)

https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/sparsh-x-dataset d360/20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz bytes 0-80,000,000 (127 MB of lego_dip.mcap decoded: schemas, channels, messages) and the gzip trailer of three archives
unconfirmed: Rates are message rates measured over the first 2.4 s of lego_dip.mcap (D360 topics) or its first 0.7 s (RealSense), not stated rates; the card states 30 Hz images, 400 Hz IMU, 48 kHz microphones and 200 Hz pressure.
pressure_topic unit not stated (values 93,600-93,900, Pa by range); the GHT sensor reads 101,827 for ambient pressure.
hours=4.5 is the paper's figure 8 value for the Allegro hand; the interpretation as sensor-hours is ours (8 x 8.5 min x 4 = 272 min = 4.5 h).

Release extent: if every bag in 20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz records like lego_dip (~124 MB/s, compression to ~63% in the gzip stream), the 30.4 GB archive holds about 6-7 min of recording. Not checked.

The 20240601 'metahand' sequences (knife, pan, spatula) are labelled tool metahand_v1 with allegro_joint and franka_joint true in info.yaml, i.e. Allegro hand on Franka holding tools; none of their sensor data is in the release.
Camera model and mount are not stated; topic names say RealSense.

download.format: tar.gz per recording set: <n>-<object>/info.yaml, <n>-<object>/<bag>.mcap (ROS 2, ros2msg schemas, uncompressed chunks) and <n>-<object>/seqs/<k>-<object>-<action>-<surface>/{metadata.yaml, data.pickle -> dangling symlink}
download.total_size: 89.5 GB in 5 archives; Allegro part 30.4 GB (20240830-fre-metahand) + 2.4 MB (20240601-fre-metahand)
download.partial_fetch: Stream the tar.gz from byte 0 and stop early: the first 80 MB of compressed stream yielded the first 127 MB (2.4 s) of lego_dip.mcap, which parses as MCAP record by record. Reaching a later bag needs every byte before it.

channels.name: /d360_<i>/image_raw/compressed
channels.frame: per fingertip sensor d360_0..d360_3 (finger order not documented)

channels.name: /d360_<i>/tactile_image
channels.note: second image topic, ~100-125 KB per frame; how it differs from image_raw is not documented

channels.name: /d360_<i>/pressure_topic
channels.shape: PressureD360 {ts uint64, pressure float64, temperature float64}
channels.unit: not stated (pressure ~93,600-93,900, Pa by range; temperature ~50, degC by range)

channels.name: /d360_<i>/pressure_ap_topic
channels.shape: PressureAPD360 {ts, seq, ch_a uint16[25], ch_b uint16[25]}
channels.note: message rate; 25 samples per channel per message

channels.name: /d360_<i>/imu_raw_topic
channels.shape: ImuRawD360 {ts, sensor_ts, type (1 acc, 2 gyro, 3 mag, 6 linacc), x, y, z float32}

channels.name: /d360_<i>/imu_quat_topic
channels.shape: ImuQuatD360 {quat (x, y, z, w) float64, accuracy}

channels.name: /d360_<i>/binary_tactile_array
channels.note: all zero in the checked messages

channels.name: /realsense/depth/image_rect_raw, /realsense/aligned_depth_to_color/image_raw
channels.note: the /compressed depth variants are empty (88-byte messages)

channels.name: /tf, /tf_static, /robot_description, /rosout
channels.note: tf_static includes allegro_link_*_tip, reskin_link_* and palm_reskin_link frames

episode_index.where: metadata.yaml per sequence and info.yaml per recording inside each tar.gz; GitHub config/data/d360.yaml lists the SSL sequences (dataset_list: 114 entries, 5 from 20240830-fre-metahand)

sample.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0 (card YAML) allows non-commercial redistribution with attribution; the repo is public and ungated. Label the collection 'CC BY-NC 4.0'. The only way to get data is to stream 20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz from its start.

episodes.why: The only bag confirmed in the release; two 20-30 s windows with contact on several fingertips, chosen after streaming it.

episodes.id: next .mcap member of 20240830-fre-metahand.tar.gz (name unknown until reached)
episodes.task: dip (marble tray) or pour (water bottle), per config
episodes.why: A second task, if the next member is a different sequence.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~8.3 GB of compressed stream for the whole first bag (100 s); the second bag adds a similar amount; a 30 s window at the start of the first bag needs ~2.5 GB
sample.rules_applied: 3 tasks or fewer (dip LEGO, dip marble, pour), so 2-3 episodes per task and 3-10 in total, but only the first bag is reachable without reading the archive in order. Windows of 10-60 s are cut from the 100 s bags. Contact check per window: Digit 360 pressure above rest for >= 1 s and visible change in the tactile images. Raw RealSense topics are dropped; the compressed colour topic is enough for the viewer.
deviations: Episodes cannot be picked before streaming: the archive has no index and the dataset card's data.pickle files are dangling symlinks.
